# C# Course Assignments

A comprehensive collection of C# programming assignments and laboratory works, covering fundamental language features and Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) principles.

## 📌 Project Overview

This repository serves as a centralized location for various C# assignments completed during the course. It includes practical implementations of core programming concepts, ranging from basic data structures to advanced OOP patterns.

## 📚 Topics & Assignments

The project is organized into several modules, each focusing on specific C# features:

- **Core Fundamentals**
  - Arrays & Jagged Arrays (`ArrayTasks.cs`, `ArrayAndStringTasks.cs`)
  - String Manipulation (`StringTasks.cs`, `ArrayAndStringTasks.cs`)
  - Enums and Structs (`EnumTasks.cs`, `StructTasks.cs`, `EnumAndStructs.cs`)
- **Object-Oriented Programming**
  - Classes and Constructors (`ConstructorTasks.cs`, `Employee.cs`)
  - Properties and Indexers (`PropertyTasks.cs`, `Indexer.cs`, `GetSet.cs`)
  - Inheritance and Polymorphism (`Inheritance.cs`)
  - Method Overloading (`Overload.cs`)
  - Static Members and Utility Classes (`StaticTasks.cs`, `TemperatureConversion.cs`)
- **Real-world Modeling**
  - Library Management System (`Library.cs`)
  - Console-based Graphics (`ConsoleSquare.cs`)

## 🚀 Getting Started

### Prerequisites
- [.NET SDK](https://dotnet.microsoft.com/download) (Version 6.0 or later recommended)

### Installation & Execution
1. **Clone the repository:**
   ```bash
   git clone https://github.com/[your-username]/csharp-course-assignments.git
   ```
2. **Navigate to the project folder:**
   ```bash
   cd csharp-course-assignments
   ```
3. **Build the project:**
   ```bash
   dotnet build
   ```
4. **Run the application:**
   ```bash
   dotnet run --project Assignments
   ```

> **Note:** Different assignments can be tested by uncommenting the respective method calls in `Assignments/Program.cs`.
